History of Cyprus: Primary Documents

History of Cyprus

Cypriot Syllabary

Example of ancient Cypriot writing system. Written on bronze.

(5th century BC)

Histories
 of Herodotus Book 5

On this page the conquest of Cyprus by the Persians is recorded.

(420 BC; Greek with English translation)

The Anabasis of Alexander

Ancient history of the campaigns Alexander the Great. Includes involvement of Cyprus in chapter 17.

(300's BC)

The Library of History of Diodorus Siculus

History written by Sicilian historian which includes several passages on the history of Cyprus.

(English translation, 30 BC)

Excerpt from 
Geographica

This text written by Greek historian Strabo includes passage on geography and history of Cyprus.

(English translation; 7 BC)

Pausanias' Description of Greece

Ancient travel guidebook of Greece, includes passage on Cyprus including a reference to the mythical founder of Salamis, Teucer. See 1.3.2

(English translation; 2nd century)

Florus: The Expedition to Cyprus

The fate of the islands was sealed; and so Cyprus too was taken over without any fighting.

From the Epitome of Roman History at 
LacusCurtius

(2nd century AD; English translation)

Letters of Isocrates

To Philip. See sidebar for selections of his other many works.

(English translation; 4th century)

Chronicle of Theophanes

Chronicle by Byzantine cleric. He includes section about the treaty which split rule of Cyprus between the Byzantium and the Arab Caliphate. This arrangement lasted centuries.

(Russian translation; 815)

A Reading in the History of the Maronites of Cyprus From the Eighth Century to the Beginning of British Rule

Chronological explanation of Maronite history including excerpts from source documents. Maronites form an ethnoreligious group in Cyprus and Lebanon.

(English translation; 10th-18th centuries)

Two accounts of the conquest of Cyprus by Richard I

Two separate histories of the British conquest of the Cyprus during the crusades.

(1191; English)

Le procés des templiers
: The trials of the Knight Templar

Proceedings against the Templar Order, including trials in Cyprus. See also 
Volume 2
.

(Latin; 14th century)

Historical Maps

From the Bank of Cyprus Cultural Foundation

(1562-1914; Greek and English; facsimiles)

Menaion for the month of June

Manuscript from the DeGreorio Collection of Antiquities. Decorated headpiece with interlace

(16th century; facsimile)

Ὕμνος εἰς τὴν Ἐλευθερίαν

The National Anthem of Cyprus, also Greek National Anthem. Adopted in 1966.

(1823; Greek with English translation)

The Cyprus Convention

Secret agreement transferring control of Cyprus to UK from the Ottoman Empire.

(June 4, 1878, English)

Cyprus As I saw it in 1879

Personal account of a visit to Cyprus by Sir Samuel White Baker.

Provided through 
Project Gutenberg
.

(1879; English)

Cyprus Annexation Order

In this order Britain claimed complete ownership of Cyprus upon the outbreak of WWI.

(November 5, 1914; English)

JDC Cyprus Collection

Accounts from concentration camps of Jews: letters, lists, reports, and other documents.

From the 
JDC Archives
.

(1945-1949; English facsimiles)

Referendum on Enosis

Unofficial referendum carried out by petition by the Cypriot orthodox church. 95% voted in favor of union with Greece. Text of petition and results.

(January 1950; facsimile, German translation)

US Documents on Enosis in Cyprus

Collection of mid 20th century US documents on the possibility of Cyprus joining Greece.

(1952-1954; English)

Foreign relations between Cyprus and the US

Documents from 
US State Department
 and 
University of Wisconsin-Madison
.

1955-1957

1958-1960

1961-1963

1964-1968

1969-1972

1973-1976

(1955-1976; English transcriptions)

Cyprus Critical History Archive

Historical documents about the violence in Cyprus preceding and following the independence of Cyprus.

(1955-1964; facsimiles)

Cyprus Hidden History

Documents relating to Greek proposal to partition Cyprus.

(1956; facsimiles)

Zürich Agreement

Agreement between Turkey and Greece outlining conditions for the establishment of an independent state of Cyprus.

(February 11, 1959; English)

Documents Relating to the Founding of Cyprus

Including The 
Treaty of Guarantee
, Treaty of Alliance between the Republic of Cyprus, Greece and Turkey and Declaration by the Government of the United Kingdom

(1959; English translation)

Constitution of the Republic of Cyprus

Constitution ratified shortly after Cyprus gained independence in 1959. Still recognized today despite partial breakdown.

(August 16, 1960; English translation)

Treaty Concerning the Establishment of the Republic of Cyprus

Treaty between Great Britain, Greece, Turkey, and the new Republic of Cyprus.

(English; August 16, 1960)

Cyprus Treaty of Alliance

Treaty between Greece, Turkey and Cyprus forming a three way alliance.

(August 16, 1960; English translation)

Cyprus Treaty of Guarantee

Treaty in which independence and integrity of Cyprus guaranteed by all parties.

(August 16, 1960; English translation)

UN Resolution 186 (1964)

Resolution on internal conflict in Cyprus. UN peacekeeping horses were dispatched at this time, and they remain to this day.

(English; March 4, 1964)

Archbishop Makarios on the invasion of Cyprus by Greece

Archbishop Makarios delivered this speech to the UN security council.

(English translation;  July 19, 1974)

Population Exchange Agreement

Agreement allowing free movement of Greek and Turkish Cypriots to move South or North respectively. Resulted in Turkish North Cyprus and Greek Cyprus.

(English; August 2, 1975)

Declaration of Independence by the the Turkish Cypriot Parliament

Provided by WikiSource.

(November 15, 1983; English translation)

Constitution of the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus

Constitution of Northern Cyprus, which is not officially recognized by any nation except Turkey.

(English translation; November 15, 1983)

Condemnation of the "Turkish Federated State of Cyprus"

Resolution of U.S. Congress condemning the existence of Northern Cyprus.

(February 3 1984; English)

Cyprus Problem

Small collection of documents on ongoing occupation of part of Cyprus by Turkey.

(1996-1999; English)

[%22001-144151%22
} Case of Cyprus v. Turkey]

Decision of the European Court of Human Rights on alleged violations against Greek Cypriots by Turkey.

(2001; English)

European Social Survey

Cyprus official data files and documents, including country files, parents' occupation, and sample data.

Files available for download

(2002-2016; Greek; English interface)

Accession to the EU

Treaty and other documents concerning Cyprus' admission to the European Union. Part of 
EUR-Lex
, a European Union (EU) law database.

View other accession treaties 
here
.

(2003; English)

Transcript of negotiations about Cyprus

Decision to unite Cyprus by cooperation of opposing political leaders Papadopoulos and Denktash.

At UN headquarters.

(13 February 2004; English transcription)

Meeting between the Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Cyprus & the Minister for European Integration of Albania

Highlights of the meeting include the assertion that EU enlargement in the Western Balkans is one of the priorities of the Cyprus Presidency of the Council of the EU, and the expression of appreciation on the part of the Albanian Minister at Cypriot support for Albania’s European integration.

(3 December 2012; English)

Maps, Laws and Digital Collections

Lekythos

(facsimiles)

Collection of peace agreements entered into by Cyprus.

(English)

Cyprus page of the 
World Documents Library
.

(photos; facsimiles)

World Law Guide: Legislation Cyprus

Collection of Cypriot Laws.

International Law Directory: Cyprus

Statutes, criminal and civil codes, and other legal materials.

A portal of the BYU Law School.

Guide to Law Online: Cyprus

Library of Congress guide to constitutional, legal, and government documents.

International Civic Coats of Arms: Cyprus

Also contains a collection of coats of arms for other European countries and principalities.

(Facsimiles)

Cyprus European and International Conventions

Lists Cyprus agreements in international legal matters.

Information is in Microsoft word documents downloadable from above link.

(Greek transcriptions)

UN Documents on Cyprus

Collection of documents on the Cyprus problem. Provided by the Permanent Mission of the Republic of Cyprus to the united Nations.

(English)

Map Collections: Cyprus

Collection of historical maps of Cyprus.

(facsimiles)
